inspection.code:
WITH query_embedding AS (
  SELECT %s::vector AS emb
)
SELECT "productId", name, color, price,
       1 - (embedding <=> (SELECT emb FROM query_embedding)) AS similarity
FROM pellier.product_catalog
WHERE "imgUrl" IS NOT NULL
  AND embedding IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (tags ? 'archive')
ORDER BY embedding <=> (SELECT emb FROM query_embedding)
LIMIT %s;
inspection.codeNote: Source excerpt from services/vector_search.py; selected columns abbreviated. The two bind parameters are the query embedding and candidate limit. Category filtering happens in the tool after this baseline query.
inspection.provenance: Recorded 16 Sep 2026. SQL log: 277 ms. Tool audit: 2249 ms. Terminal receipt: 25183 ms. These measurements cover different scopes. The two chat spans belong to the specialist, not a complete count of all model calls. Source SQL checked at revision 9298587f; the streamed SQL text was truncated.

inspection.code:
SELECT r.id, r.product_id,
       p.name AS product_name,
       r.reason, r.status, r.requested_at
FROM pellier.returns r
LEFT JOIN pellier.product_catalog p
  ON p."productId" = r.product_id
WHERE r.customer_id = %s
ORDER BY r.requested_at DESC;
inspection.codeNote: Source: routes/operator.py, _RETURNS_SELECT. The bind value for this recording is CUST-JESSICA. This is one of the client-evidence queries; 1,004 ms measures the combined read, not this statement alone.
inspection.provenance: Recorded 16 Sep 2026 in a new Operator session. The saved response reports READ_ONLY_COMPLETE and zero proposed actions. The Strands Graph took 9,078 ms in the Pellier backend process. Return counts are observations from this recording, not a claim about a fresh workshop account.
